messages:
maria_cs: Quick sync — prepping quarterly exec brief for AlderTech (renewal in ~45d). Need slide owners + top 3 risks. Draft Figma here: https://figma.com/file/abcdefg — I'll paste current health + asks below.

aj_solutions: Got it, I'll own adoption & cost slide. Will pull 30/60/90 adoption metrics + three charts.

ken_product: I can handle roadmap/feature-asks slide. Can we call out any SLA gaps and mitigation options?

sophie_exec: @maria_cs please ensure the exec TL;DR is a single slide with 3 clear bullets. Also include the renewal ask (net-new vs price).

tom_se: I'll collate onboarding blockers. Quick note — two customers still on legacy connector; there may be latency/regression items to call out.

lisa_cs_manager: I'll own enablement pulse + training completion rates. Also capturing feedback snippets from last 2 weeks for the "customer voice" slide.

calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: QBR dry run — Tue 10:00 AM PST. Invites sent to the team.

maria_cs: Thanks — action items (short):
1) aj_solutions: adoption metrics + top 2 charts — due Fri EOD
2) tom_se: onboarding blockers + hostnames list (confidential if needed) — due Thu EOD
3) ken_product: feature gaps + formal ask language — due Fri EOD
4) lisa_cs_manager: enablement slide + 2 customer quotes — due Thu EOD
5) me: compile 6–8 slide deck + exec TL;DR — due Mon noon
Please reply with :thumbsup: if you can take these.

aj_solutions: :thumbsup: Fri EOD works for me.

tom_se: :thumbsup: I'll add the connector hostnames and blockers.

ken_product: :eyes: One potential ask will be a discounted pilot for Dedicated capacity — I'll include an impact calc (cost vs performance) on the ask slide.

sophie_exec: Note: if renewal risk > 30% escalate to me. Keep that number visible on the risk slide.

lisa_cs_manager: Capturing two customer quotes for the slide: "Support was incredibly responsive" and "We need clearer docs for webhooks" — I'll attach source threads.

maria_cs: Also tracking renewal-risk matrix — moving BetaCorp to AMBER based on usage dip + a billing dispute. Suggested mitigation: short-term commit discount + implementation SWAT with Tom.

tom_se: I'll own the SWAT schedule. Need 3 eng slots next week for integrations.

aj_solutions: Quick question — for the cost slide do you prefer token-spend trend or per-feature cost breakdown? I can do both but will prioritize.

maria_cs: Per-feature preferred; keep token trend in appendix.

ken_product: Draft ask language for exec slide:
```
We recommend a 9-month renewal with a 15% committed capacity discount in exchange for 6-week implementation support and fortnightly business reviews.
```
Thoughts?

sophie_exec: Looks good. Add an expected ARR impact and a short ROI bullet for the execs.

lisa_cs_manager: I'll pull training completion rates and a succinct quote to show impact on adoption.

maria_cs: Final dry run Tue 10:00 AM PST. I'll post the full deck link Mon noon. Last request — if you add sensitive numbers or hostnames mark them: [CONFIDENTIAL].

aj_solutions: Noted.

tom_se: Will mark hostnames as [CONFIDENTIAL] in the appendix.

maria_cs: Thanks team — quick replies really help. I'll update this thread when the deck link is live :rocket:
